title: Drawings
subtitle: Shapes and points the other scenes cannot place

scenes.title: Why a hexagon grid
scenes.narration: A grid of squares and a grid of hexagons, each with one cell in the middle.

steps.say: A square touches the side neighbours along an edge, one step away.
But the corner neighbours only touch at a point, and the diagonal is further.
A hexagon has six neighbours, and every one is the same distance away.

scenes.title: Meaning as a direction
scenes.narration: A language model places each word as a point, and similar words land near each other.

steps.say: Here are four words: man, woman, king and queen.
The step from man to woman is a direction in this space.
Take the same step from king, and you land next to queen.
